input.quote: Thereafter, this Agreement shall automatically renew for subsequent one (1) year periods unless either party provides the other party with written notification at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of the initial five (5) year term or any one (1) year renewal thereof of its intention to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 11.1 provides automatic renewals of one (1) year each — not multi-year — and either party (including us) may prevent renewal on just 30 days' written notice, which is within the preferred ≤30-day window and well inside the fallback (≤60 days) and walk-away (>90 days) thresholds. Renewal is symmetrical, so the exit right benefits us. Two preferred sub-elements are absent but are not material deviations: there is no Commerce One obligation to send a 60-day renewal reminder, and there is no express cap on renewal-period price increases (no uplift or escalation language appears anywhere, including the support and maintenance fee provisions, so no uncapped increase is granted either). We would note these in negotiation but they do not warrant a redline.
